turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome in. I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Hello, Doctor. Well, I came in because... I seem to be spending far too much of my day just checking things. I keep opening the same folders, my desk drawers, and these labeled boxes I have, again and again. I just have to make sure my important papers and keepsakes are exactly where I left them. 

The frustrating part is, I'll do this even when I just checked them a few minutes before. I just can't seem to stop myself from looking.

symptom_reasoning.S066: The patient describes repetitive checking behaviors, repeatedly opening folders, drawers, and boxes to verify the location of papers and keepsakes, unable to stop even after just checking.

turns.doctor_question: When you feel the urge to check these items repeatedly, does it feel like an unwanted, anxiety-provoking urge you wish you could stop, or does it feel more like it's just your natural way of keeping things properly organized and correct?
turns.patient_response:
It's definitely unwanted. I really wish I could stop. It doesn't feel like I'm just being organized, because... well, even when I know better, a thought will just keep needling me. 

I'll suddenly start worrying that I might have accidentally thrown away my husband's old tax papers, or... or maybe I put a family recipe in the wrong box. And I just can't seem to let it pass. If I try to ignore it, I just sit there feeling like I've done something terribly careless, and the only way to fix that feeling is to go look again.

symptom_reasoning.S066: The patient reports engaging in repetitive checking behaviors ('go look again') as the only way to relieve the anxiety and distressing feeling caused by the intrusive thoughts.

It's just that specific worry about losing something important, or... or being careless with my husband's things. Aside from that, I don't have anything else like that bothering me.

I lose whole afternoons to all this checking. And then, well, I feel too embarrassed to have anyone come over because the apartment is still in such disarray from me going through everything. So it definitely gets in the way of my normal routine.
